plan: With a high private value of $29, my goal is to win the auction while minimizing my payment. Since values are drawn independently and I'm risk-neutral, I'll bid strategically near my true value. I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of the possible range to increase my winning probability. A bid around $15-$16 balances the likelihood of winning with minimizing overpayment. This approach maximizes expected profit given the single-round nature of the game.

With a private value of $29, I want to maximize my potential profit. Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$20, my value is significantly higher than typical range. I'll bid strategically to win while minimizing overpayment. A smart approach is to bid close to, but slightly below the maximum typical range - around $19.50. This increases my chances of winning while protecting potential profit margin.
